headline: Outlets differ on how much Musk spent on the midterms, agree he lost
summary: Elon Musk poured enormous sums, reported variously as $400 million, nearly $500 million and $446 million, into the 2026 US midterms through PACs, but outlets agree his candidates largely lost, including every Senate race his America PAC spent most on. In Texas specifically, his PAC's $47 million for Ken Paxton's campaign also failed.
